idempotency_key.description: UUID v4 for idempotent re-runs. Same key + same input must produce byte-identical output after canonicalization.

ba_brief_ref.description: Filesystem path to a BA output directory (output-{idem8}/) produced by eliciting-banking-brief v1.2+. Skill reads output.json from this directory.

ba_brief_inline.description: Full BA output.json contents inline. Mutually exclusive with ba_brief_ref. Used by workflow engine for in-memory stage hand-off.

tl_design_ref.description: Optional path to TL Design output (when available). v1.0.0 records the path and emits tl_design_dependencies findings if absent.

environment_inventory_ref.description: Optional path to environment inventory YAML/JSON. When present, validates env feasibility per test case.

tier_hint.description: Operator override of BA-inferred tier. Looser-than-BA emits tier_downgrade_warning requiring human override (TM-11).

prior_test_plan_ref.description: Path to prior test plan for incremental update. v1.0.0 accepts but ignores; v1.1+ may consume.

audit_mode.description: Audit trace verbosity. enhanced (default) records every mapping decision per test case.
